newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Casablanca stocks close higher ahead of earnings.
newsitem.headline: Casablanca stocks close higher ahead of earnings.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed on Wednesday 1.16 percent higher, with leading stocks rising on talk of good annual results, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 463.50 points, up from 458.21 points on Tuesday.

"The largest capitalisations like ONA group, Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce Exterieur, Societe Nationale d'Investissement increased on rumours of good annual results," Ahmed Benyahia, broker at Upline Securities, said.
ONA group jumped 17 dirhams to close at 591 dirhams.
Morocco's second largest conglomerate Societe Nationale d'Investissement was up 10 dirhams to close at 560 dirhams.
Wafabank, a liquid stock which recently merged with Spanish Uniban bank, remained unchanged at 565 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur was up eight dirhams to 420 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie rose nine dirhams to close at 331 dirhams.
Credit firm Eqdom Credit, which announced a capital increase recently, was up 24 dirhams to close at 832 dirhams.
Brewery firm Brasseries du Maroc, gained 44 dirhams to close at 1527 dirhams.
Samir refinery shed two dirhams to close at 240 dirhams.
"The worst performer is Samir refinery which found no buyers to set up a hard core of shareholders, so people tend to cede their stocks whatever the price is," Benyahia added.
Morocco planned to sell 31 to 51 percent of Samir to foreign investors before December 1996 after it floated 25 percent of its stake early last year.
Traded volume on the official market was 50.8 million from 26.6 million dirhams on Tuesday.
